text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hoping it would help clear Nakayama Festa's head, as she's been in a slump lately, I visited the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hello. Fancy meeting you in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, since Nakayama-san trusts her own intuition,
I didn't picture her turning to divine help...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well. Sure, I don't pray to gods for help...
but I can at least say hello, can't I?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Miracles, coincidences, timing...
Providence and luck definitely exist.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm greeting them ahead of time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
When things are outta my hands...
I don't want heaven turnin' its back on me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see. Now that you mention it,
dice rolls are also left to luck.
That thrill is what makes it fun.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Look at you, catching on.
I knew you had potential.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm gonna go say a quick hello.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pray at the shrine alongside Nakayama Festa.
Sensing a presence, I look over to find
Eishin Flash praying beside us as well.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Flash, you came to visit the shrine too?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I came for a change of pace.
However, seeing you pray, Nakayama-san,
made me want to pay my respects as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The official shrine etiquette is "two bows, two claps, one bow."
Nakayama-san's bow seemed a little shallow, though...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It was so sincere and full of respect.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I truly felt the sincere heart of Japan.
Thank you so much for this wonderful experience.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"No... Wait, is that really
something I should be thanked for...?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Good grief... You truly are a strange one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Whether thanks to Eishin Flash's words or the combined effect of three people's prayers, Nakayama Festa's spirits lifted, and she seems to have gotten her groove back!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Excuse me, do you have enough time?
Please, go ahead and visit the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm? Aren't you going to pay your respects, Flash?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I came here for a change of pace.
I'll relax a bit more, and then pay my respects on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's nice and quiet here.
I come by sometimes too.
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we take it easy?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh crap! The ice cream is melting, it's melting!
Isn't there anywhere to sit down?"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Let's sit by that stone!
Wait, the bear's face is all melted, that's hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Was it because I put off saying hello...?
Talk about having zero patience...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by all the racket, she couldn't pray peacefully or clear her head... and Nakayama Festa wasn't able to get back into form...
